Springfield Properties plc
15 September 2026
Final Results and Publication of Annual Report
Springfield Properties (AIM: SPR) announces results for the year ended 31 May 2026.
Revenue £243.7m (2025: £280.6m), adjusted PBT £12.9m (2025: £20.1m).
Basic EPS 7.91p (2025: 11.86p). Net bank cash £1.2m at 31 May 2026 versus £20.9m net bank debt.
Private housing revenue £165.0m (2025: £155.8m), affordable housing £54.3m (2025: £49.4m).
Land sales £14.1m (2025: £60.5m). The board proposes a 3.0p dividend (2025: 2.0p), subject to shareholder approval.
The company intends to commence a share buyback programme.
The strengthened balance sheet enables development of more Central Scotland sites rather than their sale.
An initial agreement covers 293 homes across six sites in the North of Scotland.
Final deferred acquisition consideration of £20.7m was paid after year-end.

note.takeaway: Springfield reports growth in private and affordable housing revenue, a higher proposed dividend and plans for a share buyback. Lower land sales reduced reported revenue and profit.

what_changed.today: The stronger balance sheet allows Springfield to develop more Central Scotland sites rather than sell them. In the North, an initial agreement covers 293 homes across six sites.
what_changed.read_through: Springfield has more financial flexibility, but net bank cash is a year-end figure, before the subsequent acquisition payment.

note.analyst_view: Springfield has more financial flexibility, but net bank cash is a year-end figure, before the subsequent acquisition payment.

Transense Technologies PLC
15 September 2026
Contract award with Continental to develop next-generation tyre management tool
Transense has secured a development and supply contract with Continental.
Translogik will develop a bespoke version of its handheld TLGX device.
Following successful completion of this funded six month development programme,
production is expected from Q2 2027, with deployment opportunities across Continental's global service network.
Continental has been a customer for several years.
Subject to completion of development, the board expects annual revenues of more than £0.7m from future deployments.
